environment.label: m1-baseline
environment.notes: Raw Audiveris 5.11.0 on the generated seed corpus (30 pieces x 4 input variants); no Lilyscan repair stages applied. Compiles/bar-check columns run the pipeline (engine MusicXML -> IR -> LilyPond -> Q1/Q2) on each engine output; Boxes and ECE come from the M3 .omr reader. Dev laptop: Intel i7-8550U (4 cores), 8 GB RAM, two Audiveris processes in parallel plus other work, so s/page is inflated by contention.
